name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
summary: A bench press on an inclined bench that shifts emphasis to the upper chest and front delts.
setup: Set the bench to a modest incline of about 30 degrees; steeper angles shift work to the shoulders.
Lie back with eyes under the bar, feet flat, shoulder blades pulled back and down.
Grip slightly wider than shoulder width and unrack with straight arms.
Set the safety arms or use a spotter.
execution: Inhale, brace, and lower the bar under control to the upper chest.
Keep forearms near vertical and elbows about 45-70 degrees from the torso.
Press up until the arms are straight over the shoulders.
Rack the bar with control once the set is done.
cues: Shoulder blades pinned to the bench
mistakes: Bench set too steep: drop the angle so the chest, not just the shoulders, does the work.
Elbows flaring wide: tuck them to protect the shoulders.
Excess back arch and ribs flaring: keep glutes and upper back down on the pad.
Lowering to the neck: bring the bar to the upper chest instead.
